gaps.term: Gaussian weights move between frequency sets
gaps.quote: The move between the two sets of frequencies uses Gaussian weights
gaps.note: The page says the move between the two frequency sets uses Gaussian weights, and defines only what such weights are (factors whose exponent is quadratic in the frequency index). It does not show how those weights turn the length-q transform into power-of-two tensor transforms, so the reader cannot check the claim that the reduction works.

The page asserts that each source transform is expressed through a power-of-two tensor transform, and that the reduction moves the work to power-of-two lengths. The reader is given the motivation (radix-2 needs power-of-two lengths) but not the identity that yields the decomposition, so the claim cannot be checked from the page.
